apps.name: ViboGram
apps.subtitle: ViboGram stable
apps.localizedDescription: Hybrid Telegram fork for iOS — Swiftgram's base plus features ported from AyuGram4A (anti-delete, ghost mode, local Premium unlock) and Margelet (formatting effects, expandable input, badges) and some vibe✨

apps.name: ViboGram Beta
apps.subtitle: ViboGram beta
apps.localizedDescription:
Same hybrid Telegram fork as ViboGram, but with the Python plugin system and a JIT-unlock mechanism for other experimental features.
Contains experimental features, may have a lot of bugs.
